summary: Submitted a successor of the startup-replay experiment that tests the same batch-capacity boundary at MaxAppendEntries=1024: 131,072 committed entries (128 batches) against 131,073 (129 batches). Native feedback showed the 128-batch case returning in 45 ms while the 129-batch case did not return in five seconds, so the retained receipt should show the boundary tracks the batch count rather than the default entry count, closing the limitation that no non-default boundary had been exercised.
